items.label: NVDA — thesis
items.detail: Dominant AI-compute franchise trading at ~23x forward EPS with ~80% growth; buy-on-weakness, but a binary Q2 FY27 print (Aug 26-27) sits days away.

items.label: Price / cap
items.detail: Down 0.68% on the day, +15.5% YTD, ~9% below the $236.54 52-wk high; ~$5.2T market cap on ~24.29B shares.

items.label: Valuation
items.detail: 45x trailing FY26 non-GAAP EPS ($4.77) but only ~23x FY27 consensus (~$9.3); PEG ~0.4 — cheap vs its own history and growth.

items.label: Growth
items.detail: FY26 revenue $215.9B (+65%), NI $120.1B; Q1 FY27 revenue $82B (+85% YoY), Data Center $75.2B; FY27 consensus ~$394B (+83%).

items.label: Q2 FY27 earnings
items.detail: Reports on/around Aug 26-27; guide ~$91B ±2%, consensus ~$92-95B. Stock priced for a beat; 2.2 beta amplifies any guidance miss.

items.label: Drivers
items.detail: Blackwell in full production, Rubin ramping H2-CY26 (3-4x FLOPs), networking ~doubling, sovereign AI ~92% share (~$30B, ~14% of revenue).

items.label: Key risks
items.detail: AI-capex/circular-financing bubble narrative (Burry, Altman caution), China/H20 export on-off ($8B/qtr swing), hyperscaler concentration, custom-silicon competition.

items.label: Consensus
items.detail: ~36 of 37 firms Buy; average target ~$305 (range $180-$500), implying ~40% upside; sell-side raised FY27 EPS toward $9.3.

items.label: 12-mo scenarios
items.detail: Base ~$300 (+39%), Bull ~$400 (+86%), Bear ~$180 (-16%) — favorable but skewed, event-driven risk/reward.

items.label: Reporting currency
items.detail: Confirmed U.S. dollar — NVIDIA is a Delaware/SEC filer; 10-K/10-Q and all investor materials are reported in USD.
